# oncallalert_service_label (Resource)

A label on a service. Import with `<service_id>/<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oncallalert_service_label" "team" {
  service_id = oncallalert_service.api.id
  key        = "example.com/team"
  value      = "backend"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Label key, e.g. `team/name`.
- `service_id` (String)
- `value` (String) Label value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<service_id>/<key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <service_id>/<key>
terraform import oncallalert_service_label.team 3f0c.../example.com/team
```
